meta.name: herdr-opencode-server
meta.description: OpenCode's server in a Herdr pane (herdr-nono-plugin). The server runs the model loop and every tool. Egress goes through nono's proxy with every domain allowed, so the internet stays reachable for proxy-aware clients while direct TCP connects, including to localhost services such as the OpenCode host service on 127.0.0.1:4096, are denied. Pathname AF_UNIX mediation keeps Herdr's control socket, systemd, D-Bus and the SSH and GPG agents out of reach. The plugin grants the workspace root and the server's listen port per launch.
